findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies locking the Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 10 minutes, but omits the lockout duration, unlock or recovery mechanism, and user-facing error response.

findings.evidence: him
findings.rationale: The pronoun "him" has multiple plausible antecedents among the Librarian, the Member, and the Guarantor.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved "TBD" placeholder instead of specifying the password-reset token expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ("user-friendly", "easy to navigate", "loads rapidly", "standard connections") without measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved "TBD" placeholder for the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Describes only the happy-path eligibility validation and receipt issuance without specifying system behavior when an item is ineligible or validation fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a cap on active hold requests without specifying the actual numeric limit.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows a Member to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously, contradicting SD-009 which caps checked-out physical items at 5.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, contradicting SD-010 which specifies 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Permits unverified self-registration with only an email address and immediate book checkout without ID verification, contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email address, and phone number.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: States that reserved items on the pickup shelf remain held indefinitely until cancelled by the Member, contradicting SD-011 which cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses stacked "and/or" connectives, leaving it ambiguous which combination of actions is mandatory when an item becomes 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without specifying which role or system component reviews, approves, and records overdue fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: Uses the subjective loophole qualifier "if appropriate", making SMS due-date alert dispatch optional and untestable.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved "TBD" placeholder for the payment receipt retention duration.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Assesses an overdue fine of $1.25 USD per day with no cap, contradicting SD-019 which sets the fine at $0.50 USD per overdue day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Allows a Member to renew borrowed items regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, contradicting SD-020 which blocks Members with unpaid fines exceeding $5.00 USD from renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron
findings.rationale: Introduces the term "Patron" for the borrower entity referred to as "Member" in earlier requirements (beginning in SD-001 and in SD-009 for the 5-item borrowing limit).

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ("quickly", "many users") without defining measurable latency or concurrency thresholds.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Uses the non-binding qualifier "where possible", making query-term highlighting in result snippets optional and unverifiable.

findings.evidence: sufficient; acceptable
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ("sufficient", "acceptable") instead of measurable ISBN matching accuracy and response-time targets.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large; noticeable
findings.rationale: Uses vague, unquantified terms ("efficiently", "large", "noticeable") without specifying batch size, throughput, or acceptable system degradation limits.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds when a Librarian attempts to delete a bibliographic record, but omits the resulting system action (such as blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Contains an unresolved "TBD" placeholder for the full database backup interval.

findings.evidence: important; in a timely manner; an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses vague, unquantified terms ("important", "in a timely manner", "an appropriate period") without defining which administrative actions are audited, logging latency, or retention duration.

findings.evidence: shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging event FAILOVER-01 when the primary database node is unreachable for more than 10 seconds, omitting the actual failover, traffic redirection, or recovery behavior.

findings.evidence: adequate; clear
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ("adequate", "clear") instead of specifying concrete transport security standards and authentication error-message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any Member password of at least 8 characters, contradicting SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, contradicting SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires storing Member passwords with reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt them, contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
